subject: objectdata_template_catalog
claim: On r806919, TemplateManifest.xml names 117,676 ObjectData templates in 27 archives; those templates decode into 24 classes, and the top 100 classes comprise all 24, which share class CoreTemplate and class PropertyClass as ancestors while their nearest bases are eight different classes.
how_to_repeat: Read Bin/revision.dat from your own install and confirm it reports r806919.Wizard_1_610.
Build contrib/tools/ambrose-template-catalog with the configured Project Ambrose Windows build tree and its existing static libraries.
Run ambrose-template-catalog with your own install, matching type dump and a private --output path outside the install and repository.
Check that the report's class_counts sum to object_data_templates, then compare top_100 and common_direct_bases with the class graph in the same type dump.
Run client template --list on your own install and compare its ObjectData entry count and archive count with the catalog summary.
evidence: The existing client tool listed 137,423 total template manifest entries across 27 archives; 117,676 entries had an ObjectData/ path.
The cataloger decoded every ObjectData entry successfully and reported 117,676 templates across 24 classes; the per-class counts sum to 117,676.

Class counts in descending order were: WizItemTemplate 76,679; WizGameObjectTemplate 15,255; RecipeTemplate 12,402; GameObjectTemplate 8,012; ItemBundleTemplate 1,810; ReagentItemTemplate 867; WizPolymorphTemplate 679; SoundDefTemplate 649; PetSnackItemTemplate 478; BoosterPackTemplate 301; DynamicTriggerTemplate 214; WizPetTemplate 143; WizCinematicActorTemplate 85; ItemSetBonusTemplate 42; CinematicDefTemplate 24; GoldAmountTemplate 15; CurrencyTemplate 8; LunariAmountTemplate 4; ItemTemplate 2; TourneyTokensAmountTemplate 2; WizMountTemplate 2; CinematicActorTemplate 1; EquipmentTemplate 1; SigilDynamicTriggerTemplate 1.

Only 24 distinct ObjectData template classes occur, so the top 100 classes are all 24. They share class CoreTemplate and class PropertyClass as ancestors. The type dump lists each class's base chain nearest first, and the first entries name eight different nearest bases: WizItemTemplate for 8 classes, CoreTemplate for 7, GameObjectTemplate for 3, WizGameObjectTemplate for 2, and ItemTemplate, DynamicTriggerTemplate, CinematicActorTemplate and CinematicDefTemplate for 1 each, so no nearest base is common to all 24.
disproof: A repeat on r806919 that finds a different ObjectData manifest count, a class-count sum other than 117676, a template that cannot be decoded, or different shared ancestors or nearest bases among the ranked classes would disprove this catalog.
